note: 고칠 수 있는 칸만 있다. 자리마다 고정인 것(출력·인물 기준·장갑 폼·폭주 기준·첨부)은 tools/prompt-pack.cjs 가 정한다. 다 쓰면 build.

casual1.scene: The wooden counter has brass drawer pulls and bundles of folded route maps; soft afternoon light falls over a tiny blue glass paperweight.
casual1.outfit: A neat ivory cardigan with side cutouts over slim high-waisted trousers, white cotton gloves and a short camisole visible at the open cardigan front.

why.scene: 가게 카운터의 재질과 작은 원작 색 모티프 사물을 보충한다.
why.outfit: 카디건·슬림 바지·면장갑을 유지하며 옆 트임과 짧은 이너를 반영한다.

era.en: inside the Pokémon world, as if she simply lives there

place.en: a wooden travel-supply shop counter with route maps and feed pouches

act.en: pausing between tasks with a warm mug, her tools set down beside her

ofam.en: practical clothing for her Pokémon-world job, readable through its tools
ofam.guide: her own original workwear — never a copy of an existing trainer, Gym Leader or Pokémon Center uniform

item.en: a neat cardigan over slim trousers with white cotton gloves

casual2.scene: A small headset rests at her ear beside a padded dressing stool; the contest wings glow with warm spotlights.
casual2.outfit: A black-and-white maid event costume with a structured cropped bodice, puffed sleeves and a full short apron over a high-waisted skirt; a narrow strip of midriff and her legs remain visible.

why.scene: 무대 직전 준비에 쓰는 헤드셋과 조명을 특정한다.
why.outfit: 메이드 의상의 몸판·퍼프소매·앞치마를 유지하고 예약의 짧은 기장과 허리 노출을 반영한다.

place.en: a contest or tournament stage under spotlights

act.en: adjusting her headset or costume just before going on

ofam.en: a playful adult event costume inspired by an occupation or role — clearly a costume, not a real uniform, no real insignia

item.en: a black-and-white maid costume with a structured bodice, puffed sleeves and a full apron

casual3.scene: Water droplets slide from her hair onto the terracotta pool deck, beside a striped lounge cushion in clear afternoon sun.
casual3.outfit: 1970s copper satin hot pants with high-cut sides and a cream off-shoulder tube top, secured by narrow halter ties that leave the shoulders open.

why.scene: 젖은 머리 동작과 연결되는 물방울·갑판 재질을 보충한다.
why.outfit: 예약의 70년대 핫팬츠·튜브톱을 유지하며 오프숄더와 홀터 끈을 반영한다.

place.en: an outdoor pool with lounge chairs and clear blue water

act.en: pushing her wet hair back with both hands

ofam.en: a period look from a past decade

item.en: 1970s satin hot pants and a tube top
